# Native badges <img src="markdown-badge.svg" alt="build"> and ![status](markdown-badge.svg)

Inline badges retain intrinsic size. Links and surrounding text stay selectable.

```sh
echo 'first block'
printf 'second line\n'

```

```python
print('independent second block')
```
